{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (e.g., >70% above recent high) by 10-20% in next 5-7 days.",
    "Adjust downward bias in forecasts when sentiment history includes negative values (e.g., -0.25 or 0.00) — apply 5-15% downward correction.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction: if forecast is >15% above 15-day moving average, reduce by 5-10% over next 3-5 days.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment history shows sustained negative sentiment (e.g., 3+ consecutive 0.00 or -0.25 entries).",
    "For forecasts with high volatility (>10% daily change), apply smoothing: reduce peak values by 5-10% and extend decay over 7-day horizon.",
    "When true outcome is significantly below forecast (e.g., >15% under), assume model overconfident — reduce next forecast by 5-10%.",
    "If forecast is consistently above true outcome over 3+ consecutive days, apply downward bias correction of 5-10% per day until convergence."
  ]
}
